summary.ko: 기존 페이지의 제목·구조·링크·색인 신호를 확인 가능한 증거로 점검합니다.
summary.en: Review an existing page’s content, metadata, links, and discoverability signals.

exclusions: Search content planning before a page exists

required_inputs.description: Page HTML, rendered content, or an authorized public URL
Target reader task, page purpose, and available search context

workflow.instruction: Inspect title, description, headings, content focus, links, images, canonical and robots signals when available.
Compare the page’s main answer and information hierarchy with its stated purpose and target intent.
Identify broken or conflicting signals, thin sections, confusing metadata, and relevant structured-data opportunities.
Prioritize fixes by evidence and implementation effort; separate page-level observations from site-wide or indexation unknowns.

deliverables.name: On-page SEO findings
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Each finding includes location, evidence, proposed change, priority, and verification method

limitations: Do not infer actual indexing, traffic, or rankings from page markup alone.
Structured-data eligibility and current guidance require authoritative verification.
permission_boundaries: Do not change live metadata, submit indexing requests, or modify site-wide robots settings.
Do not crawl unrelated private areas or bypass access restrictions.
